_about: Published error-rate figures for named AI detectors. Every entry names its source. 'checked' records how far this project verified it: 'primary' = read in the primary source; 'summary' = seen only via a search summary or secondary report; 'vendor' = the detector's own claim. Detectors change models silently: a figure describes the version that was tested, on the text that was tested. 'population' says which writers a figure describes ('general' or e.g. 'non-native'); a figure for one population is never applied to another. Last reviewed 2026-11-21.
